description: Finds silence-separated events and re-spaces them onto a REGULAR metronome grid: event ONSETS are placed at lead_silence + k*(60/tempo), by editing silence only - the events themselves are untouched ('INFO: 4 events found'). Detection is EXACT digital zeros (source: ibuf[i]==0.0, no threshold): a run of >= minsil ms of true zeros separates events. On material with NO such silences this mode does NOT refuse - it warns 'WARNING: WARNING: only 1 event found: Change inter-event silence ??' and emits a near-passthrough (2 s in -> 1.9999773 s out, one frame short, max residual 3.5e-4; the static duration row rides this path). On event material the real duration is lead + (n_events-1)*beat + last_event_len, verified 4-dp exact on five probes (two fixtures, three tempi) - it can be longer OR shorter than the input, so treat the static model as the flat-material baseline. Events longer than one beat overrun into the next slot and merge (no gap in the output). Deterministic; stereo accepted.
musical_use: The rhythm-quantiser: turn an unevenly-played phrase of separated notes, words or hits into a strict pulse at the tempo of your session - prosody becomes meter without any pitch or timbre change. It was built to lock spoken phrases to a beat so several takes align rhythmically; it works just as well to mechanise sloppy percussion or to force a rubato phrase into loop-ready time. Choose tempo so the beat exceeds your longest event or successive events will run into each other (beat >= longest event keeps every gap audible). Pair with retime 10 to even the levels after re-spacing, or render a clicknew track at the same tempo to check the lock. Material must have TRUE digital silence between events - gate first if it doesn't, or use retime 1 with hand-marked peaks.

tempo.description: Output grid as a metronome mark; beat = 60/tempo s (CDP quote '(0.000000 to 6000.000000)' plus runtime rule 'Output tempo vals must be > 0 AND less than 1 (beat duration) OR >= 20 (MM)'). DUAL-UNIT: values < 1.0 are read as beat DURATION in seconds (0.7 verified = 0.7 s beat); curated bounds pin the MM form, use execute() for the seconds form. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

minsil.description: Minimum run of EXACT-ZERO samples that separates events (CDP-enforced '(0.045351 to 10000.000000)' at 44.1 kHz, floor = 2 sample periods, srate-dependent). Breakpoint refused (parameter 2).

pregain.description: Gain applied to the input signal (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 1.000000)'; 0 refused at runtime 'ERROR: Pregain parameter of zero, will produce silent output.'). Attenuation only - it cannot create the zero-runs detection needs. Entry default 1.0 (positional, always emitted). Breakpoint refused (parameter 3).

examples.expected_use: Onsets land 0.5 s apart after the original lead-in; output = lead + 3*0.5 + last event length (1.97 s from the 2.5 s reference fixture).

examples.description: Slow grid: one event per second.
examples.expected_use: Every gap stretched/shrunk to put onsets 1.0 s apart; events shorter than 1 s keep audible silence between them.

known_issues: EVENT DETECTION = EXACT ZEROS (source ibuf[i]==0.0; no threshold exists). Noise-floored recordings are ONE event: this mode then warns ('WARNING: WARNING: only 1 event found: Change inter-event silence ??', doubled verbatim) and near-passes-through instead of refusing - exit 0, output ~= input (one frame short, residual <= 3.5e-4). The declared static duration model is exactly this baseline.

REAL duration on event material: lead_silence + (n_events-1)*(60/tempo) + last_event_length, verified 4-dp on 5 probes - slower tempi EXPAND the file well past indur (the engine watchdog is the guard; the static pre-flight under-predicts).
Events longer than one beat overrun their slot and merge with the next event (verified: no zero-gap in the output where a 0.55 s event met a 0.5 s beat).
tempo < 1.0 switches units to beat-seconds (dual-unit, verified); [1, 20) refused at runtime.
Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart); stereo accepted (2-ch, duration matches mono prediction).
